meta.title: Counter offer dialog shows original vendor value next to the counter value

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ Master QCS containing a vendor bid.

args.goal: On the RFQ Master QCS, click Counter Offer beneath a vendor's name, enter 90 in the Price field, and verify that the open counter-offer dialog displays the vendor's original value and the entered counter offer value side by side; leave the dialog open without sending the offer.

steps.note: Directly verifies the dialog contents and comparison between the original vendor value and the entered counter value, which no dedicated assertion step exposes.
Confirm the counter-offer dialog remains visible after the comparison is checked.
